title: Master Mascara® Volumizing & Lift

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, crueltyFree, antioxidants, siliconeFree, parabenFree, fragranceFree

descriptionHtml:
✓ Lengthening✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Volumizing✓ Long-wearing

What it is: A volumizing mascara for visibly fuller, longer, and lifted lashes—this clump-resistant formula was perfected by Mario after 25 years of artistry.

Formulation Type: Volumizing, Lifting and Lengthening

Benefits: Long-wearing

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:

-Pro tip: Mario’s first-to-market brush was created to deposit the perfect amount of product. One dip per eye is perfect for instant impact. 

-Pro tip: To get your cleanest, most natural volume, wiggle the brush at the root of the eyelash before brushing upwards towards the tip. Use narrow side of brush to apply on harder-to-reach and lower lashes. 

-Easy and gentle to remove.

Ingredients+

Highlighted Ingredients: 

-ProVitamin B5 + Castor Oil: Conditions and nourishes lashes.

-High-Performance Polymer: Provides lasting volume and lift, often found within haircare.

-Weightless Vegan Wax Blend Derived from Olives, Rice, and Sunflower Seeds: Provides buildable volume and makes lashes feel soft and non-crunchy.


Aqua, Glyceryl Stearate, Hydrogenated Olive Oil Stearyl Esters, Vp/Va Copolymer, Cera Carnauba/Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax/Cire De Carnauba, Synthetic Wax, Helianthus Annuus Seed Cera/Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Wax, Stearic Acid, Oryza Sativa Bran Cera/Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Wax, Palmitic Acid, Butylene Glycol, Olea Europaea (Olive) Oil Unsaponifiables, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Caprylyl Glycol, Sodium Hydroxide, 1,2-Hexanediol, Polyimide-1, Galactoarabinan, Rhus Verniciflua Peel Cera, Shorea Robusta Resin, Sodium Dehydroacetate, Hydroxyacetophenone, Panthenol, Lecithin, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Tocopherol, Ascorbyl Palmitate, Citric Acid, [May Contain +/- Iron Oxides Ci 77499].
